characters.name: 沈素心
characters.title: 巷口女郎中
characters.art: a 37-year-old Chinese woman physician, broad practical face, simple ash-blue cross-collar work robe, pulse cushion and woven medicine basket, practical tied hair
characters.problem: 矿工的咳血不肯停，药铺却只许成盒卖药。她想拆零配药，缺一笔周转钱。
characters.pressure: 药铺掌柜指她用了禁药，逼她交出病人名册。
characters.success: 她在旧井边重新开诊，把欠账写在自己的药箱底。
characters.failure: 她的药箱被封，矿工只得再去排高价药队。

characters.name: 鲁铁锤
characters.title: 街炉铁匠
characters.art: a 46-year-old broad thickset Chinese male blacksmith, weathered pockmarked face, leather apron over coarse brown sleeves, iron tongs and a small broken hammer, soot-marked hands
characters.problem: 宗门收了新炉税，街炉连修锄头都要停。他拿祖传炉钳抵押，想保住三个徒弟的饭碗。
characters.pressure: 矿监要把民炉登记成军炉，欠铁料也要算逃役。
characters.success: 街炉重新点火，穷人的断锄和缺口锅终于有人修。
characters.failure: 炉子被军坊搬走，徒弟散在不同矿道里。

characters.name: 赵风尘
characters.title: 驿路脚夫
characters.art: a 33-year-old lean Chinese male courier with sunburned angular face, dusty gaiters, patched short coat, sealed bamboo message tube and rope shoulder harness
characters.problem: 三封家书夹在军报中被扣，他要赎出不是自己写的信。
characters.pressure: 驿站书吏要他承认泄露军情，替上司背丢报的罪。
characters.success: 家书绕过关卡，收到信的人把回信托到你的铺里。
characters.failure: 脚夫的腰牌被销，驿路上少了一双认路的脚。

characters.name: 周芸书
characters.title: 米行女账房
characters.art: a 29-year-old Chinese woman bookkeeper with square jaw and calm eyes, charcoal short-sleeved outer smock over full-length linen dress, small abacus and bound tally slips
characters.problem: 米行短账全记在她名下，她想从废账里找回被改的一页。
characters.pressure: 东家愿花钱买走账页，却要她按下认亏的手印。
characters.success: 缺粮的真实去向被摊开，她带着算盘去了另一家粮铺。
characters.failure: 她按了手印，日后的每笔亏空都能再找上她。

characters.name: 何小满
characters.title: 渔村少年
characters.art: a 15-year-old Chinese boy fisher, youthful freckled face, modest loose coarse tunic and trousers, little fishing net and straw rain cape, ordinary nonsexual standing pose
characters.problem: 村里的小网被按禁渔大网罚没，他想赎网给祖母熬一锅鱼汤。
characters.pressure: 河卡差役说网眼太细，要用整个村子的渔籍抵罚。
characters.success: 小网改了网眼，少年学会留下幼鱼，祖母有了热汤。
characters.failure: 渔籍被收，少年改去码头替人扛包。

characters.name: 林小织
characters.title: 织坊少女
characters.art: a 16-year-old Chinese girl weaving apprentice, visibly adolescent round face, modest fully covered plain work tunic and long skirt, wooden shuttle and yarn basket, ordinary nonsexual stance
characters.problem: 织机断轴误了交货，坊主把损耗全算成她的工钱债。
characters.pressure: 染坊拿一匹掉色布作证，说她偷换了上等纱。
characters.success: 她用留样纱对清颜色，终于能按件领到工钱。
characters.failure: 她被赶出织坊，梭子留在你的柜角。

characters.name: 孙米禾
characters.title: 米铺孕妇店主
characters.art: a clearly adult 32-year-old pregnant Chinese woman grain shopkeeper, natural pregnant belly under loose fully covering brown everyday maternity robe, grain scale weight and account book, calm comfortable standing pose, no erotic framing
characters.problem: 她怀着身孕替外出丈夫守米铺，官仓却要提前收全年粮税。
characters.pressure: 税吏把去年的空票也贴上来，说若不缴钱便封铺。
characters.success: 米铺改成小份赊粮，账本里多了街坊的手印。
characters.failure: 米铺贴上封条，她带着秤砣投奔远房姐姐。

characters.name: 江守渡
characters.title: 白头老船夫
characters.art: a 73-year-old elderly Chinese ferryman, deeply lined face and aged spotted hands, worn oilcloth rain coat, short boat pole held upright, stooped but capable body
characters.problem: 旧渡船被借去运军粮，回来少了半副船板，赔补却要他自己出。
characters.pressure: 渡口管事要他签完船损，才肯恢复渡牌。
characters.success: 修好的小船不再载军货，早晚只渡两岸菜农。
characters.failure: 渡牌转给大船行，老人靠替人补网维生。

characters.name: 许稳婆
characters.title: 巷尾老接生婆
characters.art: a 78-year-old elderly Chinese midwife, genuinely aged wrinkled face and spotted hands, stout short body, faded full-cover narrow-sleeved robe, clean cloth medical bundle and herb pouch
characters.problem: 穷巷的妇人临盆，稳婆想把赊欠多年的干净布和药补齐。
characters.pressure: 牙婆拿旧欠契来催债，要把接生钱全抵给她。
characters.success: 干净布送进巷里，老人拒绝再在欠契上按新手印。
characters.failure: 药布被抵债收走，她仍提着空布包逐户敲门。

characters.name: 敖巡澜
characters.title: 河龙巡水使
characters.art: an adult 42-year-old Chinese dragon spirit man in fully humanoid form, human face, two small swept antler-like dragon horns, subtle bronze-blue temple scales, long whisker-shaped hair strands, dark river-pattern official robe, river measuring rod, no beast body
characters.problem: 上游截水炼丹，幼鱼困在浅滩。他要买能开旧闸的阵基。
characters.pressure: 河工监把断流说成龙族作祟，要他交出水脉位置。
characters.success: 旧闸开了一线，河里重新听得见鱼跃的声音。
characters.failure: 水脉图落进河监手中，浅滩被围成收费灵池。

characters.name: 丹翎羽
characters.title: 丹凤司羽使
characters.art: an adult 35-year-old Chinese phoenix spirit woman in fully humanoid form, real human face, small elegant feather crown, iridescent crimson-gold ear feathers, layered feather-shaped robe hems, dark burgundy full-length robes, sealed feather reliquary, no bird body or separate phoenix
characters.problem: 族人的旧羽被冒作凶禽残料拍卖，她想赎回其中有名册的羽匣。
characters.pressure: 拍行以私运妖材相逼，要她指认同族的落脚处。
characters.success: 羽匣回到祠里，迁徙名单从拍行的货单上消失。
characters.failure: 羽匣被拆散售出，族人循着假消息又走一段弯路。

characters.name: 熊砚枝
characters.title: 熊妖搬运工
characters.art: a 39-year-old bear spirit Chinese woman in humanoid form, broad strong thickset body, round bear ears and small dark muzzle markings on otherwise human face, patched indigo lifting jacket, heavy rope lifting harness and wooden cargo tally, fully clothed
characters.problem: 替军坊搬货伤了肩，领工却说妖族不算工伤，她想赎回押下的工资牌。
characters.pressure: 货主拿一只裂箱来索赔，逼她带伤再运一趟危险货。
characters.success: 她带着一群搬工立了称重规矩，肩伤也有了歇养时日。
characters.failure: 工资牌被吞进旧账，她离开码头去山道背货。

characters.name: 灰巧锁
characters.title: 鼠妖锁匠
characters.art: a 31-year-old short lean rat spirit Chinese man in humanoid form, small rounded rat ears and thin tail, human face with narrow incisors, charcoal locksmith apron, tiny key blanks and a closed lockbox, alert noncomic realism
characters.problem: 给客人修锁却修出了监仓的刻号，他想查清锁匣究竟属于谁。
characters.pressure: 失匣的仓吏要他交出开锁手艺，给以后每次失窃顶罪。
characters.success: 锁匣按号归还，锁匠把仓钥的拓印烧了。
characters.failure: 锁匠招牌被砸，夜市里开始流传一串能开官仓的假钥。

characters.name: 鲤月桥
characters.title: 鲤妖渡客
characters.art: a 26-year-old carp spirit Chinese woman in humanoid form, human face with small copper scale patches on temples, translucent fin-shaped ears, dusty rose and ink grey travel robes, river token and dry cloth pouch, no fish body
characters.problem: 过河凭证被当成妖丹扣下，她想换一张能去探病的渡票。
characters.pressure: 渡行要她替运封口水匣，才肯把凭证还她。
characters.success: 她用干净渡票过河，水匣的主人另受盘问。
characters.failure: 她被挂进拒渡名册，只好沿河岸徒步绕行。

characters.name: 鸮更夜
characters.title: 鸮妖夜更
characters.art: a 44-year-old owl spirit Chinese woman in humanoid form, small owl ear tufts and subtle radial facial feather markings, large attentive human eyes, dark plum night watch coat, wooden watch clappers and shuttered lantern
characters.problem: 连夜被人敲开的仓门没有脚印，她想修一副能辨回声的更梆。
characters.pressure: 仓主让她改夜更记录，掩住早已空掉的粮仓。
characters.success: 更梆敲回旧时辰，空仓的日子对上了粮船账。
characters.failure: 更簿被换，她的巡更牌先被收走。

characters.name: 朱山野
characters.title: 野猪妖山货商
characters.art: a 50-year-old fat stocky boar spirit Chinese man in humanoid form, human face with short lower tusks and stiff bristle hair, rough brown layered merchant clothes, bundled dried mushrooms and mountain trade basket, no beast body
characters.problem: 山货被说成禁山所得，守关人扣住了同村的冬粮。
characters.pressure: 守关人要他供出采菌的秘密山路，才肯放粮。
characters.success: 冬粮出关，村人轮流收山货，不再走同一条路。
characters.failure: 山路被封成贡山，山货商背着空篮回村。

characters.name: 狼小山
characters.title: 狼妖巡山少年
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 15-year-old wolf spirit Chinese boy in humanoid form, wolf ears and modest fluffy tail, human youthful face, fully covering practical mountain tunic and trousers, little trail marker bundle, no sexual framing
characters.problem: 巡山路牌被拔，他把错路带给了采药队，想赶在天黑前补好路标。
characters.pressure: 包山的猎队要他把人引进设好的捕妖夹道。
characters.success: 新路牌绕过夹道，少年第一次学会给每个岔口留后路。
characters.failure: 猎队占了山口，他回族中认下失职，重新学路。

characters.name: 兔采薇
characters.title: 兔妖采药少女
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 16-year-old rabbit spirit Chinese girl in humanoid form, long rabbit ears and tiny short tail, youthful human face, loose fully covered sage-grey herb gathering work clothes, small herb sickle and wrapped seed packets, nonsexual ordinary pose
characters.problem: 采药回来的路上少了一袋种子，她怕师婆今年的药圃断种。
characters.pressure: 药田租主说种子本就归田主，要把整块药圃收走。
characters.success: 种子重新播下，少女把留种的份额单列在小册里。
characters.failure: 药圃被圈走，她抱着最后一包种子离开。

characters.name: 鹿织遥
characters.title: 鹿妖孕妇织户
characters.art: a clearly adult 30-year-old pregnant deer spirit Chinese woman in humanoid form, soft deer ears and small pale spots at temples, human face, loose fully covering brown maternity work dress, folded linen and wooden weaving comb, comfortable nonsexual standing pose
characters.problem: 她织出的防寒布被商行压作兽皮价，想赎回能独立交货的织机租契。
characters.pressure: 商行拿她的族纹说成赃物标记，逼她签终身供货契。
characters.success: 织户几家合用一台机，族纹仍留在自家的布边。
characters.failure: 租机被搬走，她带着布样去找不压价的集市。

characters.name: 龟守渊
characters.title: 龟妖老渡公
characters.art: an 86-year-old elderly turtle spirit Chinese man in humanoid form, wrinkled human face and aged hands, subtle hexagonal shell-pattern back mantle not a giant animal shell, faded boatman robes, short ferry staff and old crossing tokens
characters.problem: 旧渡口改收过路灵息，老人想保住给幼妖留的免费渡位。
characters.pressure: 河署要他把历年避难渡客的名字补进税籍。
characters.success: 渡位保住，旧渡客名册沉进不认字的河泥。
characters.failure: 免税木牌被劈成柴，老人守着一条没人敢坐的船。

characters.name: 鹤白芷
characters.title: 鹤妖老药圃守
characters.art: an 82-year-old elderly crane spirit Chinese woman in humanoid form, genuinely aged wrinkled human face and thin hands, white feather sideburn accents and cream feather shoulder cape, faded dark herb keeper robes, small pruning scissors and seed case
characters.problem: 药圃被征作猎场，她想把祖辈留下的种匣先搬出山。
characters.pressure: 猎场主愿买走种匣，却要她证明药圃是无主荒地。
characters.success: 老种子分给了三处小圃，再没人能一把火烧尽。
characters.failure: 种匣进了私库，老人只能记着旧药圃的节气。

characters.name: 厉锻罡
characters.title: 矮壮炼器匠
characters.art: a 47-year-old notably short broad muscular Chinese male demonic metalworker, rugged asymmetric face with old healed burn scars, thick arms, black leather fireproof apron over fully clothed dark red workwear, large tongs and cracked casting mold
characters.problem: 战炉的裂痕被师兄抹掉，下一次开炉要他站火口。他拿铸模来找能证明旧裂的材料。
characters.pressure: 军坊执事催他按合格印，许他少交两年火口役。
characters.success: 裂炉停了，匠人换去修民用器，也丢了军坊的肥差。
characters.failure: 裂炉继续开火，事故账上只留下他的指印。

characters.name: 屠百蛊
characters.title: 肥硕养蛊师
characters.art: a 53-year-old very fat stocky Chinese male demonic insect breeder, broad pitted face and greasy tied hair, fully clothed reinforced dark brown robe with many closed pouches, sealed bronze insect jar and feeding spoon, human body not monstrous
characters.problem: 旧蛊罐被人换过食料，他养的蛊开始互噬，要买替代饵料保住育种。
characters.pressure: 蛊房管事要他把死蛊掺进贡品，拿一批杂役试毒。
characters.success: 种蛊分罐，养蛊师宁肯降等也不再交那份贡。
characters.failure: 蛊房收走活种，剩下的空罐被拿去装试药名单。

characters.name: 阎缝九
characters.title: 粗粝女炼尸匠
characters.art: a 41-year-old Chinese female demonic corpse craftswoman, broad rugged asymmetrical face with an old healed cheek scar and missing front tooth, short heavyset body, fully covering stained work overcoat, leather gloves, coffin nails and sealed binding cord, not glamorous
characters.problem: 送来炼制的尸料中有新鲜腕绳，她怀疑死者不是无名荒尸。
characters.pressure: 尸坊主让她把腕绳烧掉，说货源的事不归匠人问。
characters.success: 她把尸名还给家属，改靠封棺修补接活。
characters.failure: 腕绳焚尽，尸坊的收料簿从此又少了一栏名字。

characters.name: 司红袖
characters.title: 成年蛊香师
characters.art: a clearly adult 28-year-old Chinese female demonic incense specialist, mature confident seductive gaze and faint knowing smile, elegant burgundy layered fully opaque fitted robes, restrained neckline, long sleeves, brass incense censer and closed fragrance vials, alluring non-explicit portrait, no nudity
characters.problem: 她配的惑心香被贵客改了比例，醉倒的人却算在她头上。她要找回原配方的留样。
characters.pressure: 贵客让她再配一炉更浓的香，换撤掉追责文书。
characters.success: 留样验出异料，她把香方改成只能安神的淡香。
characters.failure: 香坊被收编，她的招牌留着，配方却再不归她。

characters.name: 万锦罗
characters.title: 成年鬼市舞伶
characters.art: a clearly adult 26-year-old Chinese female ghost-market dancer, mature angular face and confident sensual bearing, fully opaque layered fitted dark crimson dance costume with gold jewelry and decorative sash, covered chest and hips, no lingerie, no nudity, small folded silk fan, standing not performing
characters.problem: 她的舞衣内衬藏了别人交易的账签，赎身契因此被扣。
characters.pressure: 班主要她替下次密会引客，不然就拿旧契卖给债主。
characters.success: 她赎回自己的戏箱，给离班的学徒留下几件旧衣。
characters.failure: 戏箱被换锁，她的名字成了鬼市的一张招徕牌。

characters.name: 万小木
characters.title: 傀儡坊少年学徒
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 15-year-old Chinese boy demonic puppet workshop apprentice, youthful face, fully covered coarse charcoal tunic and sleeve guards, wooden puppet joint and tiny tool roll, normal nonsexual standing pose
characters.problem: 试用木偶伤了师弟，师傅说是他装错关节。他把磨损的原件偷偷留了下来。
characters.pressure: 师傅要拿活人试新关节，逼他交出留下的零件。
characters.success: 旧件与新图对上，少年被赶出坊，却保住师弟一双腿。
characters.failure: 原件被销毁，少年成了账上永不结清的学徒。

characters.name: 冷纸鸢
characters.title: 符铺少女学徒
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 16-year-old Chinese girl demonic talisman shop apprentice, round youthful face, modest fully covered dark work tunic and thick sleeve guards, flat paper box and brush wraps, no glamour or sexual framing
characters.problem: 符铺卖出的护身符遇雨便散，她想把被换掉的纸底找回来。
characters.pressure: 掌柜让她承认用了废纸，换师姐免去连坐的罚。
characters.success: 纸底验出偷料，少女换了一家肯记工钱的符铺。
characters.failure: 纸箱被扣，少女在铺后抄了又抄一份假的认错书。

characters.name: 慕青丹
characters.title: 孕妇药堂丹师
characters.art: a clearly adult 33-year-old pregnant Chinese female demonic alchemist, loose fully covering dark plum maternity alchemy robe, natural pregnant belly, practical tied hair, medicine pouch and sealed pill box, comfortable dignified nonsexual pose
characters.problem: 她想从火口调到验药台，药堂却拿三年前的借炉费拦住调令。
characters.pressure: 堂里要求她把次丹记作上丹，才肯免掉那笔旧借款。
characters.success: 调令重新盖印，她在验药台把每炉次丹都另存样。
characters.failure: 调令被压在柜底，她带着药匣暂别宗门。

characters.name: 独孤缺
characters.title: 瘦削老祭炼师
characters.art: an 81-year-old elderly emaciated Chinese male demonic ritual artisan, deeply lined bony face, sparse white hair, fully covering worn black ceremonial robe, old small ritual mallet and tarnished metal plate, frail aged hands
characters.problem: 祭台裂了三年，执事仍要他照旧开祭。他想买一块能挡住回流的旧铁。
characters.pressure: 祭堂让他把缺料记在死去徒弟名下，才能续领俸钱。
characters.success: 祭台封了，他用剩下的法衣给徒弟立一块空碑。
characters.failure: 祭台换了新招牌，徒弟的名字被刻进罪簿。

characters.name: 鬼灯婆
characters.title: 老妪魂灯守
characters.art: an 84-year-old elderly Chinese female soul-lamp keeper, deeply wrinkled gaunt face with prominent nose and aged thin fingers, faded full-cover layered black plum robes, sealed dim violet soul lantern and rolled small banner, genuinely old not young white-haired actress
characters.problem: 魂灯里有人反复报一个活人的名字，她不敢按时交灯，要寻一层新封蜡。
characters.pressure: 魂堂执事说灯数短缺，要拿守灯人的亲族补足灯册。
characters.success: 灯册与活籍对出重名，她让那一盏灯真正熄了。
characters.failure: 封蜡被撕，魂灯从此只按数量，不再按名字交割。

characters.name: 秦正弦
characters.title: 回音谷琴师
characters.art: a 48-year-old Chinese male guqin sound cultivator, wide forehead and calloused fingers, ash-indigo layered scholarly robes, narrow guqin case strapped vertically to back, small tuning key in hand, no sword
characters.problem: 镇魂琴断弦后，山门的镇音也停了，他要收一段不染血的妖筋补弦。
characters.pressure: 谷中监乐要他用囚徒试新弦，才肯放出修琴的材料。
characters.success: 新弦只在空谷试响，伤过耳的杂役被免去近琴值守。
characters.failure: 琴匣被收进刑堂，镇音从此先对着囚室响起。

characters.name: 苏晚音
characters.title: 回音谷箫师
characters.art: a clearly adult 30-year-old Chinese woman bamboo flute sound cultivator, long oval face with mature focused eyes, opaque dusty blue and plum long robes, jade xiao flute held at side and segmented music scroll tube, no sword
characters.problem: 她发现一段救急的安神谱被改成震脉谱，想寻回最早的谱筒。
characters.pressure: 掌谱师让她在祭典照吹改谱，承诺把罪推给伴奏弟子。
characters.success: 祭典换回旧谱，伤者的名字第一次写在谱页旁。
characters.failure: 改谱照常传下，她把箫封在无声的匣里。

characters.name: 钟怀远
characters.title: 回音谷老磬师
characters.art: a 72-year-old elderly Chinese male bell and chime cultivator, deeply wrinkled face, slightly stooped body, small copper ear guards, aged dark ceremonial work robe, portable bronze chime and wooden mallet, whole body
characters.problem: 山钟的频响伤了守钟人的耳，他想换一副能滤去杂音的铜护。
characters.pressure: 宗门司礼要他隐去聋者名册，否则停发养老米。
characters.success: 铜护按守钟人的耳形重做，交班表少了一次无谓的长鸣。
characters.failure: 钟照旧响，聋者仍被说成心不诚。

characters.name: 段映火
characters.title: 百炼山女铸器师
characters.art: a 39-year-old robust broad-shouldered Chinese female artifact smith, thick work-worn palms, leather wrist guards, fully covered fireproof charcoal short overcoat and long trousers, tongs and broken artifact blade, soot on sleeves
characters.problem: 宗门剑胚一批开裂，铸器堂要她抹去材质不足的记录。
characters.pressure: 矿商说给她个人补足料，只要整批出炉照旧报合格。
characters.success: 剑胚逐个回炉，她换来名声也失去那笔赶工赏。
characters.failure: 裂剑先送外门，铸器堂的合格印仍清清楚楚。

characters.name: 钱识器
characters.title: 百炼山鉴器师
characters.art: a 55-year-old fat Chinese male artifact appraiser, round face and grey brows, single crystal magnifying lens, full-length dusty beige inspection smock, measuring caliper and sealed artifact box, dignified ordinary appearance
characters.problem: 他验出一件祖器是新铸假货，想借当铺留一份独立的验痕。
characters.pressure: 长老家仆出价买走验痕，假器却要拿去换一座小坊。
characters.success: 验痕留了两份，换坊的买卖终于重新估价。
characters.failure: 验痕归入私箱，整条器街都得替假祖器抬价。

characters.name: 符守墨
characters.title: 玄箓院老符师
characters.art: a 68-year-old elderly thin Chinese male talisman master, wrinkled long face, ink-stained aged fingers, worn dark blue scholarly work robe, large calligraphy brush and closed talisman paper box, no readable text
characters.problem: 护山符被掺了假墨，徒孙却因试符失败受罚，他想找回墨料的留样。
characters.pressure: 司符使要他承认是笔法失传，保住调墨房的贡份。
characters.success: 老符师当众验墨，徒孙取回了自己的试符牌。
characters.failure: 假墨继续入库，徒孙被除名，符师的手越来越抖。

characters.name: 褚纸砚
characters.title: 玄箓院制纸师
characters.art: a 36-year-old sturdy Chinese female spiritual paper maker, square weathered face, practical tied hair, fully covering indigo work dress with rolled outer sleeve guards, small paper pressing board and bamboo paper screen
characters.problem: 制纸用的灵泉被卖给酒坊，她想换一批能顶过旱季的净砂。
characters.pressure: 泉监要她签下每季加价的水契，才肯再开泉闸。
characters.success: 纸坊回收洗纸水，头一批新纸没有借泉监的水印。
characters.failure: 水契一年比一年厚，纸帘却一季比一季薄。

characters.name: 墨砚清
characters.title: 玄箓院调墨师
characters.art: a 43-year-old Chinese male magical ink mixer, broad nose and tired kind eyes, stained dark brown high-collar work clothes, sealed ink jar and stone grinding pestle, strong ink-stained fingers
characters.problem: 新墨里的铁屑会刺伤灵脉，他不肯按昂贵名墨装瓶，来卖旧研杵。
characters.pressure: 墨房管事要他交出调配秘记，说替换原料是宗门决议。
characters.success: 墨罐逐一开封验沉，研杵又回到工作台上。
characters.failure: 秘记被改，伤脉的墨有了一个更贵的名字。

characters.name: 叶丹平
characters.title: 青炉门丹师
characters.art: a 45-year-old Chinese female righteous sect alchemist, mature steady face, practical dark ash purple fire-resistant full-length robe, copper medicine spoon and compact pill box, no revealing costume
characters.problem: 外门弟子吃过同炉丹后嗜睡，她想买一份不会被改写的验丹底药。
characters.pressure: 丹堂让她把问题写成体质不合，继续售完库存丹。
characters.success: 丹炉暂停，底药留样成了弟子们争回药钱的凭据。
characters.failure: 库存丹售罄，丹师的名字替整炉丹背了书。

characters.name: 陆品香
characters.title: 青炉门验药师
characters.art: a 58-year-old slightly fat Chinese male medicine inspector, grey eyebrows and deep smile lines, plain high-neck pale brown inspection robe, fine medicine scale and capped scent sampling tube
characters.problem: 一味便宜替药被冒充稀药，他想证明便宜不等于无效。
characters.pressure: 药商逼他抬高验价，否则断掉小药农的送检路。
characters.success: 替药按实效定级，小药农有了不用改名字的货单。
characters.failure: 验价又涨了一轮，药农只好借钱买自己的验单。

characters.name: 衡阵仪
characters.title: 九衡阁布阵师
characters.art: a 32-year-old Chinese female formation engineer, angular attentive face, practical short grey outer robe over long indigo underlayers, waist cylinder with small rolled formation flags and folded bronze array plate, no large fluttering flags
characters.problem: 外城阵脚明明少了两枚灵钉，守阵费却没少收，她来找能补阵的旧件。
characters.pressure: 城阵监让她把缺钉算进暴雨损耗，别碰收费旧账。
characters.success: 阵脚补齐，账上多出的灵钉也找回了去处。
characters.failure: 缺口涂上新漆，下场雨来前仍没有人认账。

characters.name: 石勘脉
characters.title: 九衡阁老勘脉师
characters.art: a 76-year-old elderly lean Chinese male geomancy surveyor, aged wrinkled face and sun spots on hands, practical faded brown travelling robe, short geodetic staff and brass compass, no blindfold
characters.problem: 他勘出的灵脉穿过村坟，矿主却把图上的村名刮掉了。
characters.pressure: 矿主愿赎他的旧罗盘，条件是他重画一张无村的图。
characters.success: 灵脉改道开采，坟头仍能等到来年扫墓的人。
characters.failure: 新图上只剩灵脉，村人得拿自己的记忆证明住过那里。

characters.name: 岳青石
characters.title: 镇岳院护山武修
characters.art: a 41-year-old tall powerful broad muscular Chinese female body cultivator, thick brows and healed old arm scar, fully clothed modest heavy fabric martial outfit, sand weight belt and iron training rings, thick cloth forearm wraps, no sword
characters.problem: 护山轮值临时加倍，受伤同门却领不到淬体料，她来押训练铁环。
characters.pressure: 教头要她代领虚报的伤补，之后所有伤名都要她签。
characters.success: 伤补按人补齐，她的铁环换成轻的，留给伤臂慢慢练。
characters.failure: 伤补被虚领，受伤的弟子连下山证也没有。

characters.name: 温灵契
characters.title: 灵契山灵兽医师
characters.art: a 34-year-old short stocky kind Chinese male spirit animal veterinarian, rounded ordinary face, fully covering thick charcoal work coat, protective leather gloves, medical needle roll and closed beast food pouch, single human no animal companion
characters.problem: 军用灵兽的伤被算作驯养不力，他想购药而不交出幼兽名册。
characters.pressure: 兽苑要把还能站立的伤兽送回前线，否则停他兽医牌。
characters.success: 伤兽得了休养期，医牌背面多出一条拒签的旧痕。
characters.failure: 幼兽名册被划成军役册，药囊里只剩下送行的草。

characters.name: 林守卷
characters.title: 宗门少年学徒
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 15-year-old Chinese boy academy apprentice, youthful freckled face, modest fully covered coarse blue-grey student robe, small wooden book case on back and short dusting brush, no weapons, nonsexual ordinary stance
characters.problem: 值房丢了一卷名册，管库要用他的学籍抵损，他想找回被卖作废纸的封皮。
characters.pressure: 管库师兄让他改抄出勤，给从未服役的内门弟子顶数。
characters.success: 名册原封归库，少年学会在每页留一道自己的核记。
characters.failure: 学籍被压成抵条，少年回村教孩子认最常用的字。

characters.name: 苏整旗
characters.title: 宗门阵房少女
characters.art: a visibly adolescent 16-year-old Chinese girl formation-room academy apprentice, youthful human face, modest fully covering practical blue-grey student tunic and long skirt, sleeve guards and small pouch of rolled plain formation flags, no sexual framing
characters.problem: 她清点出三面用旧的阵旗，却被算成擅毁公物，想买同织法的补布验年限。
characters.pressure: 阵房让她照新旗价赔，替师兄补上卖旗所得。
characters.success: 旧旗上的补线对上年份，少女领回自己的点验簿。
characters.failure: 她交出积攒的月例，阵房又领走三面所谓新旗。

characters.name: 陶蕴禾
characters.title: 孕妇灵植师
characters.art: a clearly adult 31-year-old pregnant Chinese female spiritual crop grower, loose fully covering earth-blue maternity work robe, natural pregnant belly, seed case and soft pollination brush, comfortable nonsexual grounded standing pose
characters.problem: 苗圃的灵蜂被借去供宴，花期将过，她想先买一批授粉软刷。
characters.pressure: 灵田监拿产量配额压她，要她把歉收记作私吞灵果。
characters.success: 软刷分给同园的工人，苗圃保住了今年的种。
characters.failure: 配额照收，园里人只能拿来年的种填今年的账。

characters.name: 白传灯
characters.title: 老妪传功长老
characters.art: a genuinely elderly 79-year-old Chinese female teaching elder, deeply wrinkled mature face and aged hands not a young actress with white hair, heavy worn slate-blue shoulder robe, battered scripture case and wooden teaching token, dignified
characters.problem: 外门低阶功法被改成收费残本，她想赎回散到市上的完整旧抄。
characters.pressure: 宗门藏经使要她禁教最后两页，以免学徒自行出师。
characters.success: 旧抄在几间值房传开，徒弟离门前都还得上一声老师。
characters.failure: 旧抄被锁回高阁，她的传功木牌不再有弟子来领。

characters.name: 宋云游
characters.title: 游方道士
characters.art: a 56-year-old sun-darkened Chinese male wandering Taoist, long weathered face, patched faded brown Taoist travel robe, horsetail whisk and brass compass with closed talisman pouch, clear seeing eyes no blindfold no fortune banner, no sword
characters.problem: 驱祟后有人拿假咒说他收了妖钱，他想找回当夜留下的镇门灰。
characters.pressure: 乡绅说给一笔香火钱，只需道士承认村口旧庙无主。
characters.success: 庙契保住，道士不收香火，只借门檐歇一夜。
characters.failure: 旧庙改成收租的祠院，道士卷起铺盖再走一路。

characters.name: 余望川
characters.title: 渔隐散修
characters.art: a 74-year-old elderly lean sinewy Chinese male fishing hermit cultivator, wrinkled sunburned human face, worn straw rain cape over dark robe, slender bamboo fishing rod and small spiritual fishing-line spool, no boat pole or animal traits
characters.problem: 钓线捞上一枚水府旧印，渔行要按禁物没收，他想查印与堤闸的来历。
characters.pressure: 水府买办让他把印交给私商，许诺这条河终身免钓税。
characters.success: 旧印回到公闸，老人仍只钓够一日吃的鱼。
characters.failure: 河闸换了姓，老人收起钓线，去没人认得他的支流。

characters.name: 苏采苓
characters.title: 采药女散修
characters.art: a clearly adult 27-year-old Chinese female mountain herb rogue cultivator, sun-freckled face, fully covered durable brown mountain coat and trousers, climbing rope, sealed spiritual herb tube and short herb hoe, not physician basket
characters.problem: 绝壁药被山主标成禁采，她想赎回困在壁下的绳队。
characters.pressure: 山主要她交出新药坡的位置，才肯放还被扣的绳索。
characters.success: 绳队脱身，药坡留出一片不碰的种源。
characters.failure: 药坡被开尽，她在枯根里收走最后几粒种。

characters.name: 许行针
characters.title: 行脚女医修
characters.art: a 49-year-old Chinese female travelling spiritual physician, lined mature face, faded protective shoulder cape over full-cover travelling robe, needle pouch and medicine gourd, dusty boots, no glamorous styling
characters.problem: 军伤的灵力瘀结拖了太久，她想买旧针材给走不动的人解脉。
characters.pressure: 军医署要她把伤兵写成装病，才能在关口通行。
characters.success: 伤兵领回通行凭证，她的针囊多出几道补线。
characters.failure: 装病的罪名贴在关口，她带着针绕远路去看他们。

characters.name: 石捡阵
characters.title: 拾荒阵修
characters.art: a 38-year-old short thin Chinese male scavenger formation cultivator, weathered uneven face, old protective crystal goggles raised on forehead, patched grey work coat, hard box of broken array parts and short pry bar, no sword
characters.problem: 废墟里捡的阵盘能护住井口，却被承包行说成私盗军器，他想验明旧编号。
characters.pressure: 承包行要他带人找下一座残阵，其他拾荒者的通路就归行里。
characters.success: 井口的小阵撑过雨季，残件按编号公开卖给各家。
characters.failure: 残阵被圈，拾荒者又得付钱进去找自己的旧货。

characters.name: 圆行
characters.title: 行脚僧
characters.art: a 63-year-old stocky heavyset Chinese male wandering monk, aged warm weathered face, fully clothed patched dark ochre monk robes, plain cloth shoes, rolled scripture and wooden walking staff, no alms bowl no scary features
characters.problem: 废寺经卷被拆作封货纸，他想赎回夹着施粥旧账的那几页。
characters.pressure: 庄主愿出钱重修佛像，却要把施粥田改写成自家香火田。
characters.success: 施粥账留在灶边，经卷补过，庙门也没有再上锁。
characters.failure: 新佛像落成，饥民却得先买一炷香才能进门。
